text:
maria_cs: quick heads-up — PraxisLabs has gone quiet after their PO (Elena) left last week. Notable drop in activity: internal metric shows ~78% MoM drop in API tokens. Procurement mentioned a short pilot with CompetitorX. Renewal in ~5 weeks. Can we triage risk + action items?
kelly_csm: I’m the CSM on this one — I had two calls with Elena and the new PM (Jared) last month. They were happy with onboarding but said they wanted to evaluate a lighter integration. Didn’t see a formal handover for procurement.
aj_sales: FYI renewal window matches — I own renewal. We haven’t started formal pricing conversation yet. CompetitorX pilot: I got a note from their procurement asking for a demo two weeks ago. No signed pilot yet.
noah_se: ran a quick usage check —
```
-- last 30 days
SELECT count(api_calls) as calls, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage
WHERE account = 'praxislabs'
GROUP BY date_trunc('day', ts)
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 30;
```
Result: daily tokens fell from ~1.2M/day to ~240k/day over the past 3 weeks. Also saw client traffic to competitor endpoints in request logs (host: api.competitorx.io).
sam_infra: billing/internal infra note — they downgraded their integration to async webhook mode on Mar 3 (user request). That could explain part of token drop. No errors or rate-limit spikes.
triage-bot: New risk ticket created: RISK-4473 — "PraxisLabs usage decline + procurement pilot" assigned to customer-success. Priority: high. @kelly_csm @aj_sales
kelly_csm: proposed triage plan: 1) schedule sync with Jared + exec sponsor (ops lead) this week 2) prepare 2-week "pilot keep" offer (free extended pilot + prioritized support) 3) technical delta doc comparing our integration -> CompetitorX for their use-case 4) usage snapshot + quick wins doc. @aj_sales can you take the exec outreach? @noah_se can you draft the technical delta (2 slides)?
aj_sales: I’ll take exec outreach. I can do a quick call with procurement contacts tomorrow at 10am PT. Will push for a short win checklist and ask for competitor pilot scope.
noah_se: will prep a 2-slide technical diff + 1-page appendix (latency, token-efficiency, feature gaps). ETA EOD today. Want me to include sample logs showing the endpoint differences?
kelly_csm: yes include logs + recommended mitigations (enable streaming, turn on prefix cache, and quick prompt templates we can ship). I’ll draft the ROI one-pager.
sam_infra: I can generate usage snapshots and a baseline cost delta if you need numbers for the ROI deck. Sending CSV in thread shortly.
maria_cs: thanks team. Quick escalation rules: if procurement confirms a vendor pilot today, we escalate to solutions-eng for a competitive tech swap recommendation and to Sales Leadership for counter-offer approval.
aj_sales: noted. I’ll update the renewal tracker and flag competitive pilot if confirmed.
kelly_csm: scheduling: I booked a 30m sync with Jared for Thu 11am PT and asked for the procurement contact to join. If exec sponsor available, I’ll add them.
noah_se: uploaded initial diff slides to Drive: https://redwood.app/drive/praxis/diff (internal) — comments welcome.
triage-bot: Reminder: RISK-4473 checklist updated: [exec outreach, technical diff, ROI deck, pilot offer]. Due: 3 days.
aj_sales: :thumbsup: I’ll prep call agenda and share after 10am.
kelly_csm: next steps assigned: Kelly = account lead; AJ = exec/procurement; Noah = tech diff; Sam = usage + CSV; Maria = renewal tracker & escalation. I’ll follow up in this thread after Thu call.
maria_cs: perfect — keep it tight. If we can demonstrate 2 quick wins in the exec call, reduce renewal risk significantly. Thanks all.
